scope: Selected text-state and text-positioning/showing cells; not a whole-clause certification.

tables.caption: Text-showing operators
tables.rows_note: Table 107 itself is on physical 324 / printed 309; physical 325 is following prose, not a table continuation.

errata.effect: EC3 #368 inserts the q/Q text-matrix restoration sentence in §9.4.1.
Corrects the explanatory T* sequence from TD to Td; this does not alter the stated arithmetic when the preceding TD has set leading.

implementation.behavior: TD assigns leading to -ty and then translates; double-quote updates word and character spacing before next-line/show.

cells.assertion: horizontal_scaling_reaches_the_character_spacing_too compares A origin with Tc=0 versus Tc=50 at Tz=50; expected displacement is independently 25 points.

word_spacing_moves_the_glyph_after_a_simple_fonts_space expects 50-point movement for one single-byte code 32; word_spacing_does_not_reach_a_two_byte_code_32 asserts equality for the Identity-H two-byte control, conditional on a machine face.
horizontal_scaling_reaches_the_character_spacing_too checks scale applies to character spacing; horizontal_scaling_reaches_a_tj_adjustment compares TJ displacement at horizontal scales.
leading_moves_the_next_line_downwards checks T* baseline after explicit TL. It does not exercise TD's implicit TL assignment; scratch patch adds that.
Tests use Tf in each text stream, but these selected tests do not independently test font-selection semantics.
Table 103's Tr row routes to Table 104; rendering-mode behavior is asserted individually below.
text_rise_is_not_scaled_by_the_font_size checks that Ts translates the glyph vertically without multiplying by font size.
mode_0_fills_only asserts fill command only.
mode_1_strokes_only_and_in_the_stroking_colour asserts stroke command and stroke color.
mode_2_fills_then_strokes_each_glyph_in_turn asserts fill/stroke order; separate tests cover knockout grouping.
mode_3_paints_nothing_and_still_extracts_its_text asserts no paint with text retained.
mode_4_fills_and_clips asserts fill plus clipping; the_clip_begins_at_et distinguishes delayed clip activation.
modes_five_and_six_paint_both_shows_before_the_text_clip_takes_effect asserts mode-5 timing; it is shared with mode 6.
modes_five_and_six_paint_both_shows_before_the_text_clip_takes_effect asserts mode-6 timing; separate raster/path detail is not claimed.
mode_7_clips_what_follows_and_paints_nothing asserts no glyph paint and downstream clipping.

cells.scope_limit: Table 104's rendering mode semantics have selected model/display-list assertions; not all backend raster outcomes or stroke details are certified.

cells.assertion: tstar_returns_to_line_matrix_after_text_advance distinguishes Tlm from advanced Tm; new explicit control compares TD against TL then Td.
Existing tests did not invoke TD. New td_sets_leading_from_its_vertical_operand_before_t_star expects origins (20,50), (30,38), (30,26), with explicit TL+Td equality and Td-only control.
tm_replaces_current_matrix_and_applies_rotation checks replacement translation and literal rotated transform basis.
tstar_returns_to_line_matrix_after_text_advance checks line-matrix reset after glyph advance; TD draft adds interaction with TL.
Used as control in positioning/spacing tests; no separate comprehensive Tj feature matrix claimed.
Parent read text_state::leading_moves_the_next_line_downwards: literal baselines50,38,26 cover T* then single quote; no missing single-quote assertion is inferred merely from this other file.

double_quote_sets_spacing_then_moves_line_and_shows compares operator with explicit Tw/Tc/T* sequence and expected A origin (39.5,35); new test checks those spacing values persist into later Tj at (54.5,35).

tj_positive_number_moves_left_by_thousandths_of_text_space expects 20→15 for a positive 250 adjustment at 20pt. Prior vertical composite-code-length and vertical-TJ controls passed in parent wave16b; not rerun here.
